meaningMnemonic: Life in Japan was increasing at its fastest rate during the Yayoi Period . It's one of the earliest periods of history in Japan that we know about! You should look it up, if you don't already know about it.
readingMnemonic: The reading for this word is an exception but it's the same in Japanese as it is in English. So if you just remember it's Yayoi ( やよい ) in English, you'll remember the Japanese too!

sentences.english: The beginning of the Yayoi Period was approximately 300 BCE.
